qualification_rule: A route qualifies only when a durable pre-existing fixed-community machine identity exposes a current healthy, free, anonymous, no-account one-shot operation that independently fetches or verifies an exact Agent Guild result, passport, or credential and returns identity-bound substantive evidence. Discovery, fixed-source tools, caller-supplied-only receipts, credential creation, listings, and schemas alone do not qualify.

result.reason: Dynamic Feed supplies the strongest newly audited first-party NANDA route and has exact server-side Agent Guild-fetch semantics, signed evidence, live transport, and zero monetary price. It is not anonymous/no-account: the exact proxy-witness operation requires an X-API-Key created through POST /signup. Its keyless MCP and A2A contracts omit that operation.

other_exclusions: reality_check and detect_drift grade caller-supplied claims against Dynamic Feed's fixed live-data sources; they do not fetch an Agent Guild result.
POST /v1/receipt and POST /v1/agent/receipt sign caller-supplied data or claims; they do not independently retrieve or verify Agent Guild.
POST /v1/witness signs or timestamps a caller-supplied payload/hash and separately requires a free API key.
POST /v1/vc is in security quarantine and documents HTTP 503 because it did not verify inner-receipt authenticity and role boundaries.

exact_semantically_qualifying_operation.contract: Server-side fetch a third-party public HTTP(S) URL under an SSRF guard, do not follow redirects, redact request credentials, and return an Ed25519-signed proxy-witness/v1 envelope with response status, content type, size, and SHA-256; when echo=true and the body is small, include the body.

input_shape.method: GET or another declared HTTP method
input_shape.subject: optional string

account_gate.signup_description: Get a free API key instantly.

properties.email: optional string or null, for receipts

account_gate.interpretation: Signup can be called with an empty object and needs no email or payment, but it still creates a new credential/account state and is prohibited by this audit.

independent_verification_if_keyless: The returned envelope identifies Dynamic Feed and the same key id advertised by /.well-known/keys.
The envelope records the exact nonce-bearing Agent Guild URL, HTTP 200 status, application/json content type, response size, and SHA-256.
The echoed body contains the exact Agent Guild target and substantive preflight verdict rather than an acknowledgement.
The Ed25519 signature verifies over the documented canonical form using key df-ed25519-6ca0de29113b.
Agent Guild telemetry contains one temporally matching preflight_run, used only as secondary correlation rather than identity proof.
candidate.exact_ready_condition: Expose the existing proxy-witness semantics on the already keyless MCP/A2A surface, or make POST /v1/proxy-witness genuinely keyless for bounded fair-use calls. The public contract must require no signup or credential creation and must retain the exact target, status, content type, size, SHA-256, small echoed body, signer key id, and verifiable Ed25519 signature. Re-read those public fields and report the route as ready before one invocation.

bounded_search_context.reason_search_stopped: Dynamic Feed is the only newly inspected first-party record in this bounded pass that already joins durable NANDA identity, live hosted transport, zero monetary price, arbitrary server-side URL fetch, and cryptographically signed returned evidence. Its single decisive remaining blocker is prohibited credential creation; weaker and already rejected targets were not re-expanded.

machine_product_feedback.exact_feedback: The service separates keyless read tools from identity/account-bound receipt and proxy-witness operations, and explicitly quarantines a VC wrapper whose inner receipt and claimant/signer/witness role boundaries were not verified.
machine_product_feedback.agent_guild_adaptation: Preserve AG's current distinction between a signed artifact and a verified claim, and keep issuer, subject, caller, witness, and authority roles explicit. No runtime change is established by this discovery.
machine_product_feedback.pilot_process_adaptation: For self-serve free keys, label monetary price and credential/account creation as separate gates. A zero-dollar signup is not anonymous execution.
